name: skipcheck-tm1-typescript
description: The TypeScript client for the IBM Planning Analytics (TM1) REST API and its tm1-testcontainers, as one workspace

scripts.build: npm run build -w tm1-client && npm run build -w tm1-testcontainers
scripts.pretest: npm run generate && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.test: npm test -w tm1-client && npm test -w tm1-testcontainers
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w tm1-client && npm run typecheck -w tm1-testcontainers
